score_notes.christology: we would be honored to walk with you as you seek to know the love of God through His Son, Jesus Christ.
score_notes.scripture: One of our core convictions is that God’s word creates and forms his people, and so our worship services are centered around expositional preaching.
score_notes.soteriology: trusting that the Lord will work through his Word to save sinners and to form his people into the image of Christ.
score_notes.gender: The Scripture teaches that churches should ordinarily be led by a plurality of qualified men.
score_notes.leadership: Klein Baptist Church is an elder-led, congregationally ruled church. The elders (also called pastors) teach and provide spiritual oversight and direction to the church. The congregation has the final say in matters of membership, doctrine, electing leaders, and finances.
score_notes.preaching: Our pastor explains and applies a passage of the Bible. Next Sunday, we look at the next passage in that same book of the Bible (often called Expositional Preaching).
score_notes.mission: Our cooperation with the Southern Baptist Convention means we join together with other SBC churches to support international missions, church planting, and theological education.
score_notes.cultural: a doctrinally aligned, kingdom-minded church planting and revitalization network within the Southern Baptist Convention.
score_notes.denominational: Our church is a member of The Pillar Network , which is a doctrinally aligned, kingdom-minded church planting and revitalization network within the Southern Baptist Convention.

klein-baptist-church-spring-texas.assessment: Member of the Pillar Network. Network values: church planting + church revitalization, expositional preaching, complementarian polity, SBC-cooperative, Reformed-leaning soteriology.
klein-baptist-church-spring-texas.gender_detail: Per Pillar distinctives: complementarian; male-only ordained eldership.
